data.question: PR #13 (https://github.com/brandonbews/tuhdoo/pull/13) changes .github/workflows/release.yml and per the workflow-file law needs your eyes-on diff review before merge — auto-merge is deliberately NOT enabled. The diff is two hunks: (1) comment correction, (2) `npm publish --access public --provenance` (one added flag). Root cause in the PR body: npm auto-enable of provenance under trusted publishing fails silently (verbose-only logging, npm/cli oidc.js); explicit flag makes future failures loud. Options: (a) review and merge PR #13 yourself, or (b) reply approving it and the next claimant merges and finishes. Recommendation: (a) — one-glance diff. Registry verification (dist.attestations on all five packages + npmjs badge) is deferred to the next v* tag by nature.
